source_integrity.read_method: Authenticated SSH, read-only SHA256 and extraction of existing ot_train.py:451 records; no remote write

curve.units: logged training loss and gradient norm; mean over 50 records per 5000-step block
curve.observation: All eight 5000-step block means decrease. The last block mean is 0.10046 versus 0.10602 in the preceding block; no logged late loss explosion is present. This is an optimization observation, not a closed-loop success or convergence claim.

closed_loop_evidence.final_40000_paired_initializations: 11/20 single-task versus 14/20 matched joint4; exact paired McNemar p=0.375
closed_loop_evidence.interpretation: The 10k/20k/30k probes have one rollout each and cannot estimate a checkpoint success-rate curve. Decreasing training loss and successful single probes do not override the failed final repeatability gate.

hypotheses.data_conversion_or_loader_defect: No concrete defect identified by prior full source/frame/state/action/RGB and filtered-loader parity audits; not logically ruled out for every runtime behavior.
hypotheses.insufficient_training_or_optimization_mi: Unresolved. Continued loss decrease is compatible with ongoing fitting, but neither proves more updates will improve closed-loop success nor identifies an optimal schedule.
hypotheses.multitask_interference: Not supported by the observed task0 pair (single 11/20, joint4 14/20), and not ruled out. Batch2 versus batch8 changes gradient composition, so the contrast is diagnostic rather than causal.
hypotheses.failure_stage: Unresolved. The replay approach proxy appears in only 5/14 successful traces, so its nine failure labels cannot be interpreted causally or tuned retrospectively on those outcomes.

options_compared.option: Extend or repeat the 40k run immediately
options_compared.benefit: Could test additional exposure or training-seed sensitivity.
options_compared.cost_and_confounders: New GPU cost; the present loss curve alone does not specify a falsifiable contrast, and a repeated or extended recipe changes exposure or seed without validating stage diagnostics.
options_compared.falsifying_outcome: Another low-loss checkpoint still fails the predeclared closed-loop repeatability gate.

options_compared.option: Retune stage thresholds on the same 24 replay traces
options_compared.benefit: Could raise apparent positive-control detection on the observed sample.
options_compared.cost_and_confounders: Outcome leakage; would not independently validate a necessary stage sequence or repair causality.
options_compared.falsifying_outcome: An untouched successful positive-control set fails the retuned proxy.

options_compared.option: Register a future positive-control-validated stage protocol before any new intervention
options_compared.benefit: Can separate measurement validity from policy failure and preserve a falsifiable follow-up.
options_compared.cost_and_confounders: Needs an independent, hash-pinned successful control set and a separately reviewed execution scope; no new run is authorized by this review.
options_compared.falsifying_outcome: The proposed stage observables fail on the independent successful controls or replay parity fails.

decision: Do not infer stable single-task learning from loss alone. Keep task-count expansion and Fold02 locked. Prepare, but do not execute, an independent positive-control protocol and a one-variable training/data hypothesis only after measurement validity is established.
